assets.kunlun-snow-pass.webp: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW ORIGINAL ultrawide 2:1 landscape background plate for a 2D side-view action RPG crossing an ancient Chinese mythic mountain pass. Original location: Kunlun snow-pine trail past a ruined Daoist roadside gate and small mossy weathered stone guardian on the far right edge, dark snow-laden pines and cypresses in staggered planes, torn muted cinnabar prayer ribbons, one warm lantern on a timber shrine at the far left edge. Art direction: polished hand-painted 2D video game environment, deliberately shaped big snow masses and trees, readable ink-blue and jade-teal silhouette layering, soft distant frosted mountains in cold fog, snow light as a painterly desaturated blue-white, brown trunks and a few amber accents. Chinese dark-folklore atmosphere, painterly detail, not photographic and not chibi. Scene geometry: authentic orthographic side view with broad horizontal snowy walkable foreground from y=53% through the BOTTOM edge, the feet of overlaid game sprites will be at y=79%, entire lower half must be a nearly flat continuous winter trail, medium-light blue-gray snow, shallow snowdrifts and a few dark frosted rocks at the extreme sides only. The snow ground fills the frame bottom all the way to the edge, no dropoff, no platform cutaway, no black lower bar, no water, no line dividing the floor. Use staggered darker trees in the upper half, open areas within the lower center and center-right for a hero and enemies. Vary the locations and spacing of the silhouettes so a camera can pan horizontally. No people, no characters, no monsters, no lettering, no UI, no frame and no watermark. Invent the scene independently, keeping only the broad side-view snowy forest vocabulary.
assets.shrine-street.webp: Use case: stylized-concept. Original panoramic 2D SIDE SCROLLING pixel-art background for a Chinese dark-folklore action game, 2:1 landscape aspect. STRICT side-on orthographic view with a perfectly horizontal dark cobblestone walkway across the entire bottom at 73% height, no road receding toward a vanishing point. Walkable stone top edge visible as a narrow horizontal side elevation, deep black foreground below the stones. Medium distance: deserted Kunlun village shrine and leaning homes viewed from the street, cracked white lime plaster, waxed wooden columns, ancient Chinese tiled roofs and lintels, crooked hanging prayer strips, an abandoned dark temple gate, desaturated stone incense burners. Soft deep ink-gray mountain silhouettes and wisps of fog through a few open gaps behind the buildings. Three widely spaced tungsten amber paper lanterns provide small saturated pools of light, with otherwise almost monochrome cool grey umber shadows. Rich low-resolution-looking pixel clusters with hand-painted shadowing and layered 2D silhouettes, atmospheric and dense textures, while the continuous walking line stays visually distinct from the buildings. Original ancient Chinese location, no Western buildings. No close-up character, figures, borders, HUD, text or watermarks.
assets.portrait-female.webp: Use case: stylized-concept. Original game HUD and character creator portrait on true transparent background. Adult Chinese Daoist exorcist woman, early thirties, athletic and quietly fierce, black hair gathered in a high knotted ponytail, loose short pale wisps beside one eye, narrow cinnabar cord in hair. Weathered ink-black crossed-collar Ming-inspired travelling coat, cool off-white diagonal lapel, fitted dark sleeves, split knee-length coat over loose charcoal trousers and black cloth boots, torn muted vermilion waist sash trailing behind, one small aged bronze talisman at the waist. She is dressed for a mountain pilgrimage in cold weather. Waist-up crop, oblique three quarters turned slightly towards the viewer's right, strong focused eyes, pose holding a paper Daoist talisman with two fingers near the waist, extremely clear readable shoulder silhouette. Refined hand-painted graphic-novel/anime facial treatment with restrained realistic Chinese features, beautiful subtle texture in lacquer, cloth and hair, elegant mature character, dark painterly render, thin sharp lines and natural muted color, smoky pewter highlights and warm little ember light on one cheek. Black mythic Chinese folklore world. No scenery, effects, letters, frame, logo or background. No weapon.
assets.frames-female.png: Use case: stylized-concept. A production 2D game sprite sheet containing exactly 12 distinct animations of the SAME character, arranged as a strict 4 columns × 3 rows evenly spaced regular grid, landscape 3:2 canvas. Transparent background, no gridlines, no borders, letters or labels. All figures small enough to fit completely inside an equal cell with transparent gaps on every side, feet near each cell's own bottom. True crisp 32-bit era pixel clusters with a fine pitch, muted charcoal palette and restrained sepia rim light, hard pixels, game sprite silhouette rather than miniature illustration. Orthographic SIDE view, facing screen RIGHT in every cell, same human scale and clothes in every pose. Adult Chinese Daoist exorcist woman, early thirties, athletic and quietly fierce, black hair gathered in a high knotted ponytail, loose short pale wisps beside one eye, narrow cinnabar cord in hair. Weathered ink-black crossed-collar Ming-inspired travelling coat, cool off-white diagonal lapel, fitted dark sleeves, split knee-length coat over loose charcoal trousers and black cloth boots, torn muted vermilion waist sash trailing behind, one small aged bronze talisman at the waist. She is dressed for a mountain pilgrimage in cold weather. Exactly these poses in reading order: row 1 [upright idle, walking front-leg stride, walking back-leg stride, low braced ready stance]. Row 2 [weight on back foot preparing a strike with hands held back by right shoulder, lunging forward with both hands together extended horizontally to screen right, bent front knee following through with both hands low and forward, pulling hands back upright recovering]. Row 3 [low backward dodge with shoulders back and knees compressed, recoil as if punched in chest, with right hand extended in a talisman spell, walking passing pose feet closer]. Hands visible and clenched as if gripping a thin invisible handle; absolutely no weapons or VFX in the sprites, game draws weapons separately. No ground, no ground shadow, no colored background. Each of the 12 cells contains one whole independent figure from head to toes, never overlaps other cells. Use the same true pixel-art rendering in all cells.
